authority_source.title: G4 Interaction + Ink Implementation Plan v0.2
authority_source.scope: WP G4-12 Ink Playground 0.1 / Physical Integration

supersession_policy.reason: The previous executable package encoded Windows 11 as a hard environment prerequisite, although the capability contract is about pointer ingestion, writable presentation, telemetry, and separately qualified pressure evidence.

windows_functional_smoke.purpose: Validate the runnable Windows host and pointer pipeline without making a pressure claim.
required_observations: HANDLE sourceDevice conversion produces a stable protocol device_id
pointer history/coalesced batch is accepted when the OS supplies it
visible writable canvas responds to input
HUD telemetry and a screenshot or video capture are persisted
windows_functional_smoke.pressure_fields: optional; record null or unsupported when unavailable

windows_pressure_qualified.purpose: Qualify pressure and pen metadata independently of the Windows OS-version floor.
required_observations: device metadata identifies a real pen
pressure values vary across a controlled trace
HUD and physical sample-to-visible latency are captured
capture path and SHA-256 are recorded
forbidden_conclusions: PASS_PHYSICAL without the complete G4-12 profile

g4_12_physical.host: Supported Windows desktop host or qualified Android device
required_observations: screen or video capture with SHA-256
g4_12_physical.allowed_conclusion: Complete physical evidence only after all required observations pass

verification_mapping.requirement: Windows host is runnable and accepts pointer input
verification_mapping.invariant: A supported desktop host can exercise the native ingress and visible playground
verification_mapping.failure_mode: Builds pass but the host cannot start, receive WM_POINTER, or display input

verification_mapping.invariant: A real pressure-capable pen produces non-constant pressure values
verification_mapping.failure_mode: Mouse or non-pressure pen is mistaken for pressure support
verification_mapping.oracle: Independent pressure trace and device metadata

verification_mapping.invariant: Sample-to-visible latency comes from a physical session
verification_mapping.failure_mode: Headless or app timing is reported as physical latency
verification_mapping.oracle: Capture-bound latency record with trace and screenshot/video hash

implementation_impact.required_followup: Regenerate GT-G4-12 P31 as a re-verification package after independent CONTROL_REVIEW accepts this amendment.

decision_request.acceptance_effect: Win10 and non-pressure input may produce functional smoke evidence; pressure and complete physical evidence retain separate capability requirements.
